text: 晶华微公告，公司因涉嫌信息披露违法违规等被中国证监会立案调查，2026年11月2日收到中国证监会《冻结决定书》。冻结4个证券账户，其中1个冻结回购股份57.68万股，其余3个为理财产品专用结算账户，冻结理财产品金额约2.2亿元；冻结7个募集资金专户，活期余额6418.16万元，另有结构性存款2.28亿元待到期回到募集资金户后予以冻结，冻结期限6个月。公司其余银行账户未受影响，预计不会对正常生产经营产生重大影响。
text_en: Jinghua Micro announced that the company is under CSRC investigation on suspicion of information disclosure violations and other issues, and received the CSRC's "Freezing Decision" on November 2, 2026. Four securities accounts were frozen, one of which froze 576,800 shares of repurchased stock; the other three are dedicated settlement accounts for wealth management products, with about 220 million yuan in wealth management products frozen; seven dedicated raised-fund accounts were frozen, with demand deposits of 64.1816 million yuan, and another 228 million yuan in structured deposits to be frozen after maturity when returned to the raised-fund accounts, with a freeze period of six months. The company's other bank accounts were unaffected, and no material impact on normal production and operations is expected.
